what: Behind a dark panel, three glowing tubes (threejs-components TubesCursor — three.js tubes + four lights, intensity 200) flow and bend as they follow the cursor, and drift in ellipses on their own when the cursor is outside the panel. The library loads and starts when the panel is one screen away. Once drawing begins, the canvas fades in over 1.1s and the loading cover lifts over .6s. Clicking the panel randomizes the tube and light colors
needs: threejs-components@0.0.19 (tubes1.classic.js — the part calls itself near the panel)

options.shuffle: If off, color doesn’t change on press
options.src: tubes1.classic.js address — always pass it when loading several parts bundled into one file (default is ../../_vendor/… from this fx.js location)
options.--fx-tube-1~3 · --fx-light-1~4: 3 colors for tubes, 4 for lights, default is the --kf-accent hue rotated
options.[data-fx-part=canvas]: Canvas to draw on — created if missing
options.[data-fx-part=wait]: (if any) waiting veil shown before the scene appears

note: Text sits above the canvas at z-index 2 or higher. The library bundle is 757KB, so it is not loaded when the section is far away. With reduced motion, only the dark panel is shown with no scene

from.where: Footer on every page: the original tl-site-footer TubesCursor (threejs-components@0.0.19, tubes #f967fb·#53bc28·#6958d5 · lights #83f36e·#fe8a2e·#ff008a·#60aed5)
